title: Resolve two-device identity conflict without losing either draft
description: The same commander edits an identity on two independent authenticated devices. One save wins; the other draft survives conflict and requires an explicit replacement. Read-only emulator records corroborate revisions without choosing or injecting player actions.

steps.description: Sign in on the first device and reach the identity editor.
steps.acknowledgement: The commander name field is ready after real provider login.
verifications: Eight production portraits and Save are available.

steps.description: Save Original as the shared identity.
steps.acknowledgement: The encrypted save receives an authoritative accepted receipt.

steps.description: Sign in independently on a second device and recover Original.
steps.acknowledgement: The second device recovers the saved identity.
verifications: Both authenticated devices show the same saved name.

steps.description: Edit a local Preserved draft without submitting it.
steps.acknowledgement: The editor displays the local draft.
verifications: The first device still shows the saved Original identity.

steps.description: Save Other device while the second device keeps its unsent draft.
steps.acknowledgement: The first device receives accepted save acknowledgement.
verifications: The remote save does not overwrite the second device draft and produces revision two once.

steps.description: Submit the stale draft and receive a conflict remedy.
steps.acknowledgement: The conflict identifies another device and offers explicit replacement.
verifications: The draft remains intact, no reconnect remedy is substituted, and the conflicting command has no saved effect.

steps.description: Explicitly replace the saved identity with the preserved draft.
steps.acknowledgement: Replacement is acknowledged and reaches the other device.
verifications: Both devices retain the chosen draft, with exactly one additional saved revision.
